review.reason: The recorded ordinary build disables weak TLS ciphers, contradicting the CVE's required enable-weak-ssl-ciphers prerequisite. Fixed provider code is present, but the required RC4-MD5 TLS negotiation is excluded in this build.
evidence: Verified ELF64 x86-64 target with Build-ID f62aae64a89a995a3cdb1a10f82f6bfa307b4550 and embedded debug information.
Target DWARF records OPENSSL_NO_WEAK_SSL_CIPHERS at configuration-header line 124; the cipher_rc4_hmac_md5 compilation unit imports that configuration macro unit.
DWARF and target_build.jsonl identify commit 4d346a188c27bdf78aa76590c641e1217732ca4b and the ordinary static gcc -O2 adapter build. openssl.py configure_commands does not enable weak-ssl-ciphers.
At openssl-3.0.3, ssl/s3_lib.c:2796 gates the RC4-MD5 TLS ciphersuite on OPENSSL_NO_WEAK_SSL_CIPHERS being undefined.

Disassembly confirms the provider's MAC-key lookup uses mackey. Equivalent branch fix 7d56a74a96828985db7354a55227a511615f732b is in target history; configuration exclusion, not missing selected-commit ancestry, determines this verdict.
review.suggested_action: Classify this ordinary-build testcase as not_affected; retain the original patch label as provenance.
